_meta.description: Adapted model descriptions for Tenstorrent model compatibility reference. First ~140 chars lead with distinguishing attributes; remainder covers producer and specs.
_meta.source: Adapted from AI-generated copy in internal spreadsheet, edited for voice and leading with distinguishing attributes.

bge-large-en-v1.5: Purpose-built for semantic search, dense retrieval, and RAG. BAAI, 335M.
DeepSeek-R1-0528: Reasons via extended chain-of-thought — built for math and science at fully open weights. DeepSeek, 685B.
efficientnet-b0: Compound scaling across depth, width, and resolution for efficient image classification. Google, 5.3M.
Falcon-40B-Instruct: Commercially licensed generalist trained on 1T tokens of curated web data. TII, 40B.
Falcon-7B-Instruct: Commercially licensed instruction model — lean resource footprint. TII, 7B.
FLUX.1 [dev]: Flow-matching transformer for photorealistic text-to-image with strong prompt adherence. Black Forest Labs, 12B.
FLUX.1 [schnell]: FLUX distilled to 4 steps — full quality, fraction of the compute. Black Forest Labs, 12B.
gemma-3-1b-it: Tiny and capable — instruction-tuned for edge and on-device use. Google, 1B.
gemma-3-27b-it: Largest Gemma 3 — 140-language reasoning, coding, long context. Google, 27B.
gemma-3-4b-it: Punches above its weight in reasoning and code. Google, 4B.
gpt-oss-120b: Open GPT-style model for deep reasoning in self-hosted deployments. GPT-OSS, 120B.
gpt-oss-20b: Open GPT-style generation at a practical self-hosted scale. GPT-OSS, 20B.
Llama-3.1-70B: 128K context, multilingual, tool-use ready, fully open weights. Meta, 70B.
Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct: Complex reasoning, coding, and agentic pipelines — no license restrictions. Meta, 70B.
Llama-3.1-8B: 128K context and multilingual base with a wide fine-tuning ecosystem. Meta, 8B.
Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: Multilingual instruction following, tool use, and function calling. Meta, 8B.
Llama-3.2-11B-Vision: Image + text inputs on Llama's reasoning foundation, 128K context. Meta, 11B.
Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct: Charts, image Q&A, visual documents — multimodal on a single accelerator. Meta, 11B.
Llama-3.2-1B: Sub-gigabyte base model for on-device and embedded inference. Meta, 1B.
Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct: Instruction-tuned to run anywhere — on-device at 1B. Meta, 1B.
Llama-3.2-3B: On-device reasoning with room for language understanding and light tool use. Meta, 3B.
Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct: Lightweight agent backbone for low-latency, resource-constrained deployments. Meta, 3B.
Llama-3.2-90B-Vision-Instruct: Document analysis, chart reading, OCR-level image understanding at full scale. Meta, 90B.
Llama-3.3-70B: Llama 3.1 refined — better math, code, and multilingual, same 128K context. Meta, 70B.
Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct: Stronger structured tasks, tool use, and reasoning than prior Llama generations. Meta, 70B.
mamba-2-8b-slimpj: State-space model with linear-time inference — no attention required. 2.8B.
Mistral-7B: Sliding window and grouped-query attention for fast, memory-lean inference. Mistral AI, 7B.
Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3: Function-calling and instruction following for production and agentic use. Mistral AI, 7B.
Mixtral-8x7B: Sparse MoE: 13B active per token out of 45B total — quality at low per-token cost. Mistral AI, 45B.
Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct-v0.1: Instruction-tuned MoE — strong reasoning at 13B active-token compute. Mistral AI, 45B.
MobileNet V2: Inverted residuals and linear bottlenecks — strong accuracy at near-zero inference cost. Google, 3.4M.
Mochi 1: Text-to-video focused on motion quality and temporal coherence. Genmo, 10B.
Motif Vision 6B Preview: Preview text-to-video from natural language prompts. Motif, 6B.
Qwen2.5-72B: Chinese, English, code, and structured output — 128K context base. Alibaba, 72B.
Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct: Instruction-tuned across Chinese, English, coding, and structured output at scale. Alibaba, 72B.
Qwen2.5-7B: Multilingual base for Chinese, English, coding, and math. Alibaba, 7B.
Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: Tuned for code, math, and structured output at an efficient scale. Alibaba, 7B.
Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct: Document understanding, chart analysis, and multi-image Q&A. Alibaba, 32B.
Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct: Vision-language for low-latency multimodal deployment on constrained hardware. Alibaba, 3B.
Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct: Vision-language at scale — documents, charts, and scene understanding. Alibaba, 72B.
Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct: Visual Q&A, OCR, and document parsing in a practical VLM footprint. Alibaba, 7B.
Qwen3-32B: Toggleable chain-of-thought for on-demand deep reasoning. Alibaba, 32B.
Qwen3-8B: Reasoning depth on demand without a throughput penalty. Alibaba, 8B.
Qwen3-Embedding-4B: Multilingual embeddings for retrieval and semantic similarity. Alibaba, 4B.
Qwen3-Embedding-8B: Higher-capacity multilingual embeddings for retrieval and reranking. Alibaba, 8B.
Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct: Hybrid thinking + vision — documents, charts, UI, and multi-image tasks. Alibaba, 32B.
QwQ-32B: Chain-of-thought with self-reflection for math, science, and logic. Alibaba, 32B.
ResNet-50: Skip connections that made deep networks trainable — the image classification baseline. Microsoft Research, 25M.
SD-XL 1.0-base: Dual-encoder base for high-resolution synthesis and fine-tuning pipelines. Stability AI, 6.6B.
SegFormer (b0): Mix-transformer segmentation without positional encoding — accurate at low compute. NVIDIA, 3.8M.
SpeechT5 (TTS task): Unified encoder-decoder for natural text-to-speech synthesis. Microsoft, 307M.
Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large: MMDiT architecture — strong text rendering and prompt control for image generation. Stability AI, 8B.
unet-base-vgg: Skip connections preserve spatial detail for precise segmentation — VGG backbone. 31M.
vit-base: Image patches + self-attention, no convolutions — the original vision transformer. Google, 86M.
vovnet-19b-ra: One-Shot Aggregation avoids DenseNet's redundant paths for better accuracy-per-FLOP. 11.2M.
wan-2.2-t2v-a14b: Causal video transformer for text-to-video with strong motion coherence. Alibaba, 14B.
whisper-large-v3: 99 languages, 680K hours of training audio — built for robust speech recognition. OpenAI, 1.5B.
